cruden number EO:12208 over held order texts
reasons: Identity (EO 12208, April 15, 1980, Consultations on the Admission of Refugees, 45 FR 25789) matches the held FR text. The ten-clause inventory covers every operative sentence (1-101 lead, (a), (b), 1-102(a), (b), 1-103 lead, (a)-(c), 1-104). EO 13286 sec. 49 strikes 'the following functions: (a) To', replaces the Attorney General in 1-101(a), strikes 1-101(b) and 1-102 and redesignates 1-103 and 1-104; sec. 92 makes it effective March 1, 2003, so the three Coordinator clauses end 2003-03-01 by EO 13286, as claimed. EO 12608 sec. 15 lists 12208 for the HEW-to-HHS substitution, correctly an amendment of 1-102(a). The OFR notes record only these two amending orders and no revocation; the current 8 U.S.C. 1157 note prints the surviving text as amended, supporting the operative predicate. Savings analysis of 1-104 is accurate. No unaddressed Revoked/Superseded note.

evidence_checked: OFR disposition notes for EO 12139 (Amended by EO 12333; EO 13383; EO 13475) and EO 12036 (Revoked by EO 12333)
reasons: Identity, quotes and the inventory check out, and the amendments by EO 13383 and EO 13475 to section 1-103 are accurately described; the current 50 U.S.C. 1802 note supports the operative predicate for 1-101 to 1-103. The OFR note 'Amended by: EO 12333' is addressed (EO 12333 revokes EO 12036, which 1-104 and 1-105 amended; no held EO 12333 text names EO 12139). But both terminated clauses carry first_end.date 1976-05-23, before the order was signed and contrary to the claim's own reasons (1979-05-23). A wrong end date on terminated clauses is a dated-fact error; rejected.

OFR notes: Revokes EO 11881; Amended by EO 12107
reasons: Identity (EO 12105, December 19, 1978, 43 FR 59465, FR Doc. 78-35716) matches; the seven clauses are the full operative text (the '1-161' label is the OCR form of 1-101). EO 12107 lists 12105 in sec. 2-101 and is effective 1979-01-01 by sec. 2-404, an actor substitution, not an end. The revocation of EO 11881 is correctly treated as performed on signing (1978-12-19). The U.S. Code note prints the order as amended by EO 12107 only, and the held 5 CFR part 581 authority line still cites E.O. 12105, supporting the continuing delegation and content requirements. Treating the 1-202 savings sentence as operative, with the evidentiary limit stated, follows the evidence-decides ruling. No held Revoked/Superseded note for the order.
